description: This Java source file defines step definitions for Cucumber-based BDD tests related to loan re-amortization in the Fineract system. It includes methods to create and undo re-amortization transactions and verify that corresponding events are generated.

classes.name: LoanReAmortizationStepDef
classes.description: Defines step implementations for loan re-amortization scenarios in Cucumber tests, including creating, undoing, and verifying events.

methods.name: createLoanReAmortization
methods.description: Creates a loan re-amortization transaction for the current business date by loan ID.

methods.name: createLoanReAmortizationByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Creates a loan re-amortization transaction for the current business date by external loan ID.

methods.name: undoLoanReAmortization
methods.description: Undoes a loan re-amortization transaction for the current business date.

methods.name: checkLoanReAmortizeBusinessEventCreated
methods.description: Asserts that a LoanReAmortizeEvent has been created for the specified loan.
